title: ר' יונתן בן הרכינס

paragraphs: Rabbi Yonatan ben Harkinos: his brother Rabbi Dosa called him ‘Satan’s firstborn,’ meaning sharp. Yuchasin, sequence of generations under Shimon the Righteous, writes that Rav Tzemach explained it as a firstborn of the mother, for the Gemara calls a maternal firstborn ‘a foolish firstborn.’ He was among Shammai’s students. See Jerusalem Talmud, Yevamot 1:6, what he said about Rabbi Yehoshua—see his entry—and Rabbi Akiva—see his entry—and Yevamot 16a.
